guide.cloudDesc: Pick an adapted vendor from the list (OpenAI, Claude, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiniMax, Zhipu GLM, Qwen, Doubao, Xiaomi MiMo) and fill in the API Key obtained from the corresponding platform. The Base URL and recommended model ID are pre-filled.
guide.cloudNote: Different models from the same vendor may differ in structured output, tool calling, and thinking mode capabilities. Prefer the recommended models in the list.
guide.customDesc: You can connect to cloud services, local inference services, or third-party proxies that expose an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API. Explicitly select the API protocol, then enter the Base URL and the model ID the service actually provides.
guide.faq1Body: Many local inference services lack stable constrained decoding or a full protocol implementation, so occasionally outputting extra text, Markdown fences, or incomplete JSON is common. The system falls back to local validation and automatic repair; for higher stability, choose an official cloud model instead.
guide.faq2Body: MiniMax does not recommend enabling thinking mode together with JSON mode. The system automatically resolves this conflict based on validated configuration, prioritizing the stability of structured results.
guide.faq3Body: Claude's API spec differs from the OpenAI-compatible interface, so some parameters and structured output tiers do not apply and the page shows fewer configuration options. This is a normal difference and does not affect the adapted capabilities.
guide.faq3Summary: Claude shows fewer options than other vendors
guide.security: Your API Key is stored only on your local device and is never uploaded to Marea's servers.
guide.testHintSuffix: " to run a basic check. A successful connection only means the service can respond; it does not guarantee that structured output, tool calling, or thinking mode will work.
guide.warningDesc: Actual capabilities depend on the inference service's implementation. The system does not scan ports, probe models, or auto-upgrade capability tiers. Before connecting to a third-party proxy, assess the privacy and data security risks yourself.
guide.warningTitle: Local models and custom endpoints are not covered by official technical support.

Model Compatibility

Marea automatically selects the appropriate Structured Output Profile for each vendor.
VendorStatusTierTested ModelsNotes
OpenAI⚠️ Doc adaptedA-Official protocol adapted; pending real-world testing.
Claude⚠️ Doc adaptedA-Official protocol adapted; pending real-world testing.
Doubao✅ TestedASeed 2.1 Turbo / ProRecommended; stable across the full Work flow.
Kimi✅ TestedAK2.6、K2.7 CodeRegular API recommended; Coding endpoint not advised for Work.
DeepSeek✅ TestedBV4 Flash、V4 ProRecommended; fast and stable.
Qwen✅ TestedBQwen3.7 MaxRecommended; stable performance.
GLM✅ TestedBGLM 5.1、5.2Recommended; 4.7 not advised.
MiMo✅ TestedBMiMo 2.5、2.5 ProRecommended; stable performance.
MiniMax✅ TestedMMiniMax M3Recommended; requires M-tier adaptation.
Other models⚠️ Doc adaptedD-Uses the generic compatibility mode; verify yourself.

Tier Guide

  • A: Native JSON Schema / Function Calling
  • B: JSON Object + local validation
  • M: MiniMax-specific adaptation
  • D: Generic compatibility mode (unknown models / custom endpoints)
